notes: CompletionCreateResponse ending with "error", a value the SDK's Choice.finish_reason documents (see meta.json). Not recordable on demand: it needs a generation that fails.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap FW1: Fireworks' finish_reason "error" (the generation failed) passes through as a non-canonical finish reason, and the request ends as a success with whatever text came before: the inbound translators fall back to a default and clients that switch on finish_reason miss the failure
